items.quote: As of March 2026, our total supplies stood at 250 centers and approximately 167,000 seats across 18 cities, while signed supply expanded to 266 centers and approximately 184,000 seats. Operational capacity today stands at 156,000 seats.

items.statement: Mature center occupancy sustained at 84%; blended occupancy at 76%
items.quote: All occupancy, mature centers defined as those operating for more than 12 months sustained at approximately 84%, while the blended occupancy stood at 76%.

items.statement: Targeting 200-300 bps improvement in mature center occupancy in FY27
items.quote: Broadly in this kind of a cohort, we would prefer that at least we have a couple of 100 basis point increase over the next couple of quarters.

items.statement: Revenue-to-rent ratio at 2.3x
items.quote: So the revenue-to-rent ratio for us comes around 2.3x.

items.statement: Premium Gold and Elite centers increased to 35 (27 Gold, 8 Elite) covering 8 key GCC hubs
items.quote: On the premium portfolio, we closed FY '26 with 35 Gold and Elite centers comprising 27 Gold and 8 Elite, and this segment continues to grow as a share of new supply.

items.statement: 500+ seat cohort represents 37% of portfolio mix
items.quote: The 500-plus seat cohort, which is the most premium and stickiest segment of our portfolio now represents 37% of our overall portfolio mix.

items.statement: Multicenter client penetration at 48% of client base; clients in 10+ centers up 600 bps QoQ
items.quote: Today, 48% of our client base operates across multiple Awfis centers and depth here is accelerating. Clients operating in 3 more centers now account for 31% of our seats up 300 basis points quarter-on-quarter. Those in 5 or more centers account for 18%, also up 300 basis points and the share of clients operating across 10 or more centers has risen by 600 basis points quarter-on-quarter.

items.statement: Normalized cash flow from operations at INR216 crores with operating cash flow to EBITDA at 1.01x
items.quote: On a normali zed basis, adjusted for lease liability outflows, normalized cash flow from operations was at INR216 crores, reflecting strong cash conversion with operating cash flows to EBITDA of 1.01x

items.statement: Maintained net cash position with net debt to equity at -0.20 and gross debt to equity at 0.09
items.quote: We maintained a net cash position throughout the year. With net debt to equity at negative 0.20 and gross debt to equity at 0.09, reinforcing the financial discipline that underpins our group.

items.statement: ROCE sustained at 60%+ and annualized ROE at 17%
items.quote: On returns, ROCE sustained at 60% and annualized ROE stood at 17%.

items.statement: Revenue to gross fixed assets ratio at 1.5x, best in industry
items.quote: Just as importantly, our revenue to gross fixed assets ratio came in at 1.5x, which is best in the industry, reflecting the asset productivity advantage of our capital-light managed aggregation model.

items.statement: FY26 total capex deployed at approximately INR208 crores primarily for Grade A/A+ centers in premium micro markets
items.quote: On capex, total capex deployed towards capex during FY '26 stood at approximately INR208 crores, primarily directed towards Grade A/ A+ centres in premium micro markets.

items.statement: FY26 portfolio rebalancing led to 8,000 seat closures (5% churn) but not expected to recur at same rate
items.quote: FY '26 was a ye ar of portfolio rebalanc ing for us. As we were premiumizing the network towards Grade A and A+ assets. So we thought there are certain centers which we should exit

items.statement: Expect Q1 FY27 growth to improve as high Kumbh base effect from Q4 FY26 is absent
items.quote: Q1 FY '27 doesn't have the same base effect as Q4 FY '26. And therefore, we expect that to start showing up in terms of growth.

items.statement: Domestic travel demand remains strong in peak summer season; international affected by Middle East situation and higher fares
items.quote: we do see that demand trends continue to remain strong, at least for domestic. International continues to be affected somewhat, right, because of the Middle East situation as well as the fares

items.statement: Contribution margin percentage at 39% in Q4 FY26, flat YoY; management targets absolute contribution margin and EBITDA rupee growth over margin percentage
items.quote: Contribution margin was INR121.4 crores, up 0.4% Y-o-Y, essentially flat with a contribution margin percentage at 39%.

items.statement: Willing to sacrifice 1-2% contribution margin to chase market share in flights and buses; hotels investment consumes operating leverage at EBITDA level
items.quote: On flights and buses, I would rather, at this point, chase market share as an objective and therefore, be okay with 1% or 2% less contribution margin at times.

items.statement: FY26 GTV INR18,693 crores (USD2B), up 25% YoY; Q4 FY26 GTV INR4,798 crores, up 9% YoY
items.quote: In FY26, the ixigo Group achieved 34% revenue growth and 28% adjus ted EBITDA growth Y-o-Y with a gross transaction value crossing about INR18,693 crores or about USD2 billion for the full

items.statement: Flights became largest vertical by GTV (INR2,018 crores in Q4); Buses largest by contribution margin (35% of group CM); Trains 32.7% of group CM
items.quote: In Q4, flights became our largest vertical by GTV, while buses became our largest vertical by contribution margin.

items.statement: Value-added services attachment rate over 31% in Q4; AI handles 4.35M queries, 81.5% voice and 91.1% chat resolved autonomously
items.quote: In Q4, our value-added services tax attachment rate was over 31%. Our AI systems handled 4.35 million customer queries end-to-end, 81.5% of voice conversations and 91.1% of chat conversations with our customers were resolved by autonomous AI agents.

items.statement: Launched ixigo NEXT with AI-native operating layer, proprietary small language model, traveller context memory, real-time supply intelligence, and agentic execution
items.quote: ixigo NEXT is not just a chatbot. It's not even a separate AI tab. It's not an assistant bolted onto a legacy app. It is fundamentally a new operating layer for travel.

items.statement: Train OTA market share increased to 62% from 60% few quarters ago despite policy headwinds
items.quote: we continued to gain OTA market share in trains, reaching 62% last quarter versus 60% a few quarters ago

items.statement: Indian Railways policy changes (restrictive Tatkal access, reduced waitlist inventory, Aadhaar verification) and supply constraints impacting train ticket availability
items.quote: Indian Railways has implemented several policy changes over recent quarters, including more restrictive time periods for Tatkal access by OTAs and agents, reduced waitlist inventory for the whole ecosystem, user re -verification for repea t users, Aadhaar verification norms and more

items.quote: we remain optimistic that some of these constraints could ease once the upgraded PRS system is rolled out later this year and as and when Tatkal time window policies are revisited for OTAs by the government.

items.statement: Capitalizing core AI infrastructure and platform capabilities (orchestration layer) over 5-year amortization; experimental and operational AI costs expensed through P&L
items.quote: on the amortization, it will be 5 years. And as the product, as the infrastructure layer comes up, it will be a 5-year amortization.

items.statement: No hotel-related capitalization; AI capitalization follows similar policy as past train and app builds
items.quote: this is a similar policy to what we followed in the past too when we built the train and the other apps

items.statement: Prosus fundraise from last year has 4 objective buckets; deployment timeline spans couple of years; not rushing usage
items.quote: We have time right now as in timelines are, we've still got a couple of years left for that. We don't want to rush into anything.

items.statement: Rebuilt organization to be AI-native: systems AI-readable, APIs AI-accessible, workflows AI-compatible, internal processes AI-native via internal NewCo team
items.quote: we rebuilt the organization around AI. We made our systems AI-readable. Our API is AI-accessible, our workflow is AI-compatible. Our internal process is AI-native.

items.statement: Cash flow from operations INR195.7 crores for FY26, up 60% YoY; Q4 operating cash flow INR96 crores
items.quote: I would also highlight my favorite cash flow from operations, which was up 60% for INR195.7 crores.

items.quote: Passenger segment grew year-on-year by 14%, while GTV grew 18% despite only a 1.2% growth in the market on domestic passenger segments and with a degrowth in t he market on international

items.statement: Tractor revenue expected to grow 25-30% in FY27
items.quote: Tractor revenue is expected to grow around 25–30%.

items.statement: Crane revenue from existing plant expected to grow 15-20% in FY27
items.quote: Crane revenue of existing plant is expected to grow around 15–20%.

items.quote: Ma'am, we are expecting the margin in the range of around 12.5% operating EBITDA.

items.statement: Tractor EBIT margin expected around 10% steady state
items.quote: Around 10% at EBIT level.

items.quote: The total capex is around ₹70-plus crore, out of which we have already done around ₹25 crore till date.
